fichas.title: Metalwork workshops
fichas.summary: A large metalworking business is divided into areas for gas welding, fitting, construction and repair, ornamental ironmongery, and mechanical metalwork. Offices should be centrally located with views over the workshops where possible. Welding and forging rooms should have steel doors, overhead lighting and supplementary machine lighting. The floor should be concrete, and the welding bench should have fire bricks; a charcoal pit with a small chimney and nearby water and oil containers supports pre-warming, brazing, forging and annealing.

fichas.title: Metalwork shop with machine locations and stores
fichas.summary: A large metalwork-shop layout organizes forging and welding areas, a locksmith's machine shop, assembly, sheet-metal work, raw-material storage and finished-product storage. The plan also shows a store and work benches. A separate room-relationship diagram organizes steel and light-metal processing, stores, offices, reception and open space in relation to the street.

fichas.title: Architectural ironmongery and precision metalwork businesses
fichas.summary: The plan depicts an architectural ironmongery and precision metalwork business, with stores for rods and sheet metal, a process-flow route, machine areas, work benches and a foreman's office. An accompanying diagram illustrates a working sequence linking forging, assembly, welding, drilling, grinding, cutting and storage.
